knownLimitations: Sun Disc x276 is replaced by 3068b in the LDD model.
Raised baseplate 30271px1 is replaced by a brick-built solution in the LDD model.
Raw LDD coordinate regions are discovery hints and can overlap the apparent bounds of a different assembly; established instruction-page provenance wins any conflict.
geometryCrosscheck.policy: LDD geometry may accelerate transform solving and detect reconstruction errors, but never counts as instruction-exact without matching manual-page provenance. A CAD ref already reconciled to an exact part from another manual page must be rejected as a conflicting candidate.

exactTransformRequires: part number and color matched to inventory
stud-grid position or local subassembly transform
attachment to an already resolved parent/base reference
transcriptionPolicy.anchorNeighborhoodRule: A nearby CAD record can be promoted when a captured manual visibly places that part in the same mechanism/assembly as an already exact anchor, the part/color inventory occurrence is available, and the CAD ref conflicts with no other exact claim.
transcriptionPolicy.bulkSolverRule: The full-set solver may classify all 420 slots and assign candidate geometry to complete interchangeable groups, but only manual-corroborated slots enter the instruction-exact count.
transcriptionPolicy.correctionRule: When a unique inventory occurrence is already represented by a reconstruction proxy but manual-plus-CAD evidence places it elsewhere, relocate and promote that same occurrence rather than adding a duplicate.
transcriptionPolicy.crossPageExactRefConflictResolution: existing instruction-exact provenance wins; conflicting CAD candidate is rejected
